name: Capability-driven Automation
summary: Connect business outcomes to verified technical operation semantics and, only after architectural approval, deterministic and policy-authorized Worker execution. Discovery and execution are separate delivery gates.
next_action: Rework digest PR #1360 to SHA-256 over the exact LF file bytes and add the dependency digest of built-in Worker Types (ADR-0483); configure branch protection on main with code-owner review before the first evidence record, whose PR adds CODEOWNERS for the evidence path; then evidence records with same-PR renewal enforced in CI.

slices.title: Declarative operation claims
slices.note: Complete: PR #1343 merged; ADR-0480 Accepted (2026-10-26). Claims stay descriptive and never authorize; one claim per contract id@version per operation, deliberately.

slices.title: Semantic contract envelope
slices.note: Complete: PR #1346 merged; ADR-0485 Accepted (2026-10-26) with a reservation: contract identity (id, version, profile) and immutability are binding, the v1alpha1 fields may change until the first published contract (CDA3). No provider conformance claim.

slices.title: Contract governance and conformance
slices.note: ADR-0483 Accepted (option 3), with approval by repository provenance (maintainer as sole reviewer), raw-byte contract digests and dependency digests for built-in Worker Types. CDA2a schema-only validation merged in PR #1357; digest PR #1360 in review and to be reworked to raw bytes. Evidence records, renewal, withdrawal and publication are not yet implemented; no Worker is verified.

slices.title: Verified Worker Type mappings
slices.note: Prove account versus contact distinction; source-derived provider mappings with no drift.

slices.title: Cross-layer architecture graph
slices.note: Accept/extend ADR-0420; stable identities, provenance, bounded traversals and visibility.

slices.title: Panorama and API/MCP discovery
slices.note: Read-only impact, coverage and gap queries; no unsupported runtime claims.

slices.title: Capability-aware BPMN binding
slices.note: Approve ADR-0482; keep a stable logical binding slot and explicit initially pinned Worker so a later authorized revision need not redeploy BPMN. No runtime rebinding in CDA6.

slices.title: Policy-gated governed execution
slices.note: Prove provider-specific ADR-0475 enforcement, fsync-gated effects and replay equality for the initially pinned binding. No automatic fallback or configured Worker hot-swap in CDA7.

slices.title: Controlled Worker rebinding without redeployment
slices.note: Review the proposed controlled-rebinding ADR. Operator-authorized A-to-B binding revisions affect only future jobs; existing queued/leased jobs stay pinned. Per-partition cutover, tenant/policy scope and crash/replay must be proven. No automatic dynamic selection. Review questions deferred until CDA7 has landed; the binding-slot scope is settled when CDA6 starts.
